name: Zephaniah
overview: Zephaniah was a male priest from the tribe of Levi, specifically noted as a descendant of Aaron. He is identified as the son of Maaseiah, which situates him within a priestly lineage. His role as a priest underscores his involvement in the religious life and leadership of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Zephaniah means 'YHWH has hidden' or 'YHWH has hidden as a treasure,' reflecting a divine attribute associated with protection or preservation. This proper name is not indicated as being directly given by God but carries a significant theological meaning tied to the Lord's safeguarding.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Zephaniah as the son of Maaseiah, establishing his immediate paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family connections are detailed in the biblical text provided.
scriptureSignificance: Zephaniah's importance in Scripture is grounded in his priestly heritage as a descendant of Aaron, marking him as a key religious figure. His identification as the son of Maaseiah links him to a known priestly family, highlighting the continuity of Levitical service. His presence in Jeremiah 21:1 situates him within the prophetic and priestly context of Judah's history.
